entries.proposition: The index patient had delayed myelination of the anterior corpus callosum, severe cerebral atrophy and pachygyria on MRI.
entries.snippet: MRI) revealed delayed myelination of the anterior portion of the corpus callosum, severe cerebral atrophy and pachygyria (Figure 1a)

entries.proposition: Cortex and corpus callosum volumes were 15.7 and 15.3 percent smaller in heterozygous mice than in wild type.
entries.snippet: cortex and corpus callosum volumes were 15.7 ± 5.9% and 15.3 ± 6.1% smaller in c946del+/Δ mice than in WT controls, respectively

entries.proposition: The text gives 63.6 percent of mutant mice and 12.5 percent of wild-type controls reaching generalised seizure stages after PTZ.
entries.snippet: 63.6% of c946del+/Δ mice, but only 12.5% of the WT controls reaching generalised seizure stages

entries.proposition: The legend of the seizure figure gives n = 11 wild type and n = 8 mutant mice at 3 months.
The legend of the seizure figure states that seizure severity was comparable between wild type and mutant mice.
entries.snippet: although seizure severity ( g ) was comparable between WT and c946del+/Δ mice

entries.proposition: Hippocampal telemetric EEG showed significantly more spike trains per day in mutants than in wild type.
entries.snippet: c946del+/Δ EEG recordings presented with significantly more spike trains per day (Figure 4b)

entries.proposition: The legend of the EEG figure gives n = 6 wild type and n = 5 mutant for the EEG analyses.
entries.snippet: Student’s t -test; n = 6 WT, n = 5 c946del+/Δ.

entries.proposition: Of the myelin-cluster genes only Plp1 protein was corroborated by Western blot; RPE65, MAL and CNP were unchanged at protein level.
entries.snippet: Of those, we only corroborated significantly increased levels of PLP1 protein in c946del+/Δ mice compared to WT controls, while RPE65, MAL and CNP were unchanged at the protein level

entries.proposition: O4 and Olig2 labelling were increased in mutant cortex while CNPase labelling was comparable.
entries.snippet: both O4 and Olig2 expression were significantly increased in the cortex of c946del+/Δ mice compared to WT control brains (Figure 6b), while CNPase labelling was comparable

entries.proposition: Pups were given 30 micrograms of Plp1-targeting or control ASO by intracerebroventricular injection at P0.
entries.snippet: pups at P0 were administered 30 μg of either Plp1-targeting ASOs or control (non-targeting) ASO

entries.proposition: The legend of the ASO figure lists Western blot analysis and a grip-strength test at 3 months of age as the ASO readouts.
entries.snippet: followed by Western blot analysis and grip-strength test at 3 months of age

entries.proposition: The legend of the ASO figure gives group sizes of 10, 13, 10 and 6.
entries.snippet: n = 10 +/+ ASO control, n = 13 +/Δ ASO control, n = 10 +/+ ASO PLP1, n = 6 +/Δ ASO PLP1

entries.proposition: The text states that ASO treatment restored PLP1 expression in mutant mice to wild-type levels at 3 months.
entries.snippet: ASO treatment restored increased PLP1 expression in c946del+/Δ mice to levels of WT controls at 3 months of age (Figure 7b)

entries.proposition: The authors state that the contribution of glial and white-matter changes to the network aberrations remains to be shown.
entries.snippet: To what degree the glial and white matter changes in c946del+/Δ brains contribute to the neuronal network aberrations remains to be shown.
